package pinrouting

import (
	"testing"

	"github.com/division-sh/swarm/internal/events"
	runtimecontracts "github.com/division-sh/swarm/internal/runtime/contracts"
	models "github.com/division-sh/swarm/internal/runtime/core/actors"
	"github.com/division-sh/swarm/internal/runtime/core/agentidentitytest"
	"github.com/division-sh/swarm/internal/runtime/core/flowidentity"
	"github.com/division-sh/swarm/internal/runtime/semanticview"
)

func TestConstructedParentSourceSiblingProbe(t *testing.T) {
	const owner = "test://orders/child/reader"
	childFlow := runtimecontracts.FlowContractView{
		Path: "orders/child", Paths: runtimecontracts.FlowContractPaths{FlowPath: "orders/child"},
		Schema: runtimecontracts.FlowSchemaDocument{Name: "child"},
		Agents: map[string]runtimecontracts.AgentRegistryEntry{"reader": {ID: "reader"}},
		AgentURIs: map[string]string{"reader": owner},
	}
	parentFlow := runtimecontracts.FlowContractView{
		Path: "orders", Paths: runtimecontracts.FlowContractPaths{FlowPath: "orders"},
		Schema: runtimecontracts.FlowSchemaDocument{Name: "orders", Instance: mustTemplateInstanceField(t, "order_id")},
		Children: []runtimecontracts.FlowContractView{childFlow},
	}
	root := runtimecontracts.FlowContractView{Path: ".", Paths: runtimecontracts.FlowContractPaths{FlowPath: "."}, Schema: runtimecontracts.FlowSchemaDocument{Name: "root"}, Children: []runtimecontracts.FlowContractView{parentFlow}}
	root.Children[0].Parent = &root
	root.Children[0].Children[0].Parent = &root.Children[0]
	source := semanticview.Wrap(&runtimecontracts.WorkflowContractBundle{
		RootSchema: &root.Schema,
		FlowSchemas: map[string]runtimecontracts.FlowSchemaDocument{"orders": root.Children[0].Schema, "orders/child": root.Children[0].Children[0].Schema},
		FlowTree: runtimecontracts.FlowTree{
			Root: &root,
			ByID: map[string]*runtimecontracts.FlowContractView{".": &root, "orders": &root.Children[0], "orders/child": &root.Children[0].Children[0]},
			ByPath: map[string]*runtimecontracts.FlowContractView{".": &root, "orders": &root.Children[0], "orders/child": &root.Children[0].Children[0]},
		},
		URIRegistry: runtimecontracts.ContractURIRegistry{ByURI: map[string]runtimecontracts.ContractURIRef{owner: {Kind: "agent", FlowID: "orders/child", LocalID: "reader", Full: owner}}},
	})
	parent := flowidentity.Derive(source, "orders", "one")
	child, err := flowidentity.KeylessChild(source, parent, "orders/child")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	actor := models.AgentConfig{ID: "reader", FlowID: "orders/child", FlowPath: child.InstancePath,
		Identity: agentidentitytest.Declared(t, "reader", owner, child.ScopeKey, child.InstanceID, child.InstancePath)}
	if err := child.ValidateConstruction(source, actor.Identity.RunID); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("probe prerequisite: canonical constructor rejects child: %v", err)
	}
	t.Run("flow_control", func(t *testing.T) {
		route := events.RouteIdentity{FlowID: child.TemplateID, FlowInstance: child.InstancePath, EntityID: child.EntityID}
		got, err := AdmitFlowExecutionRoutingSource(source, child.TemplateID, route)
		if err != nil || got.Route() != route {
			t.Fatalf("constructed flow source: got=%#v err=%v", got.Route(), err)
		}
	})
	t.Run("declared_agent", func(t *testing.T) {
		got, err := AdmitAgentExecutionRoutingSource(source, actor, "")
		want := events.RouteIdentity{FlowID: child.TemplateID, FlowInstance: child.InstancePath}
		if err != nil || got.Route() != want {
			t.Fatalf("constructed declared-agent source: got=%#v err=%v", got.Route(), err)
		}
	})
}
